sources.title: FunctionGemma (Function Calling) | google-gemini/gemma-cookbook | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Relevant source files FunctionGemma is a 270M parameter model fine-tuned from the Gemma 3 270M instruction-tuned checkpoint specifically for function calling and tool integration tasks. This page documents the model architecture, function calling format, and two distinct fine-tuning approaches: Hugging Face TRL and Google Tunix.

sources.title: GitHub - blumfontein/functiongemma
sources.snippet: FunctionGemma is a compact 270M parameter model designed for function calling - the ability to parse user requests and map them to specific tool/API calls. This project finetunes it on mobile device actions like opening apps, making calls, sending messages, etc.

sources.title: FunctionGemma model overview | Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: FunctionGemma is a specialized version of our Gemma 3 270M model tuned for function calling. It is designed as a strong base for further training into custom, fast, private, local agents that translate natural language into executable API actions.

sources.title: FunctionGemma — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: FunctionGemma is designed as a base for further training and can provide an efficient pathway to production-grade performance. In our evaluation on the "Mobile Actions" dataset, fine-tuning improved accuracy by 47% over the base model.
